summary: 11:45 AM ET run, published at 12:22 ET. takeaways: Louisiana Tech at Baylor over 49.5: pass. Both teams start backups: Baylor's DJ Lagway is doubtful with an ankle injury and Nate Bennett makes his second straight start; Louisiana Tech's Blake Baker misses the game with a hand injury and Trey Kukuk starts (ESPN, Sept 17: https://www.espn.com/college-football/story/_/id/49965563/sources-baylor-lagway-doubtful-play-louisiana-tech). The total opened 55.5 and is 49.5; v2's 54.7 knows about neither change.

Ohio at South Alabama over 48.5: pass. Ohio's top two quarterbacks, Nick Poulos and Matt Vezza, were hurt against Jacksonville State and freshman Levi Davis is QB1 for now (The Post, Sept 18: https://www.thepostathens.com/article/2026/09/london-demarco-everything-to-know-for-ohios-away-game-against-south-alabama). The total opened 53.5 and is 48.5; v2's 54.0 predates it.

James Madison at San Diego State over 46.5: pass. v2's 52.6 leans on an FCS rout in each two-game sample: JMU 87-3 over Wagner (https://www.espn.com/college-football/boxscore/_/gameId/401867929) and San Diego State 53-20 over Portland State (https://www.espn.com/college-football/boxscore/_/gameId/401860879).

FIU +6.5 at FAU: pass. v2 has FIU by 1.2, but no injury or role news was found for either team and the line has already moved from 7.5 to 6.5 (https://www.espn.com/college-football/game/_/gameId/401862771). Model only.
